title: Hypergolic Ionized Ceramics
summary:
Epic material. §7Obtained from expired hypergolic fuel.

§8First the gabagool fuel is vitrified through calcination, then stabilized using a phosphate-based crystalline ceramic host through an ion exchange, or something...
